impl Document

Source

pub fn add_optional_content_group( &mut self, name: impl Into<String>, visible: bool, ) -> OcgId

Add an optional content group (a layer) named name, shown when the document opens if visible is true.

The group is listed in the catalog’s /OCProperties even if no content uses it. Names are text strings, so any Unicode name works; they need not be unique.

Optional content needs PDF 1.5 and is forbidden in PDF/A-1: adding a group registers ValidationError::OptionalContent and, below PDF 1.5, ValidationError::RequiresNewerPdfVersion.

Source

pub fn set_optional_content_page_mode(&mut self, use_oc: bool)

Whether the document opens with the viewer’s layers panel showing (/PageMode /UseOC). Only written when the document has optional content groups. Off by default.

pub fn register_named_destination( &mut self, dest: NamedDestination, ) -> Option<()>

Manually register a global named destination.

Named destinations used in link annotations are automatically registered, so you don’t need to call this function for them.

Returns None if a named destination with the same name and a different destination has already been registered, and therefore could not be registered again.
